purpose: Generate research dossiers from the canonical Research Runtime object graph.

required_outputs.executive_summary: One-page summary of theme, business value, uncertainty, evidence strength and next action.
required_outputs.research_body: Question, uncertainty, hypothesis, activity, experiment, result and learning.
required_outputs.asset_body: Assets created, origin story, evidence objects, reuse paths and commercial path.
required_outputs.commercialisation: Customer problem, product offer, revenue model, buyer and proof.
required_outputs.audit_pack: Claim position, evidence grade, cost trace, risks, gaps and receipts.
required_outputs.ledger: Status, result, evidence, gaps, next_action, elevation, pressure_flags and score.

classification_rules.real: All required objects exist, evidence grade A or B exists, receipts are attached, and generation completed.
classification_rules.partial: Objects exist but evidence, receipts, cost trace or runtime generation is incomplete.
classification_rules.blocked: Missing access, missing credentials, failed dependency, or unavailable deployment surface.
